steps.en: Company notices at the third reminder stage are picked for checking
steps.id: Notice company di stage reminder ketiga dipilih untuk dicek

steps.en: The check runs on its own every scheduled day
steps.id: Pengecekan jalan sendiri setiap hari terjadwal
steps.why_en: The job is switched off in production.

steps.en: The company ID is sent to the government data source
steps.id: ID company dikirim ke sumber data pemerintah
steps.why_en: Government data connection and view names cannot be proven from the code.
steps.why_id: Koneksi dan nama view data pemerintah tidak bisa dibuktikan dari code.

steps.en: The company's latest name is saved on the notice
steps.id: Nama company terbaru disimpan di notice

steps.en: The company's latest address is saved on the notice
steps.id: Alamat company terbaru disimpan di notice

steps.en: Without an individual owner found, the notice stays with the company
steps.id: Tanpa individu yang ditemukan, notice tetap ke company
steps.why_en: The code never decides this case; the company simply stays the offender.
steps.why_id: Code tidak memutuskan kasus ini; company hanya tetap jadi offender.

steps.en: The updated company details appear on the third letter
steps.id: Data company yang diperbarui muncul di surat ketiga
steps.why_en: A previously marked letter address can still win over the new one.
steps.why_id: Alamat surat yang sudah ditandai sebelumnya masih bisa menang atas yang baru.
